name: Green Pin Bow Shackle SC
desc: Green Pin® bow (anchor) shackle with screw collar pin. The bow and pin are forged from high-tensile steel, grade 6, quenched and tempered, giving a minimum breaking load of 6× the working load limit. Hot-dipped galvanized finish for corrosion resistance, rated for −40°C to +200°C. Manufactured to ISO 2415 and EN 13889 and meeting US Fed. Spec. RR-C-271 Type IVA Class 2; from 2 t upward it complies with ASME B30.26. Working load limits 0.33–55 t, available with full DNV, ABS and 3.1 certification.
